🏡 Open House Tour | 5305 English Oak Dr, Killeen TX – Don’t Miss It! #openhouse 


✨ Reminder: Open House This Saturday! ✨
Looking for a home in Killeen with space, style, and comfort? 🏡 Come tour this 4 bed | 2.5 bath | 2,700+ sqft beauty in the sought-after Spanish Oaks Subdivision!

📍 5305 English Oak Dr, Killeen, TX 76542
📅 Saturday, Aug 23rd, 2025
⏰ 1–4 PM

What you’ll love about this home:
✅ Vaulted ceilings + spacious layout
✅ Fresh paint & new carpet (installed Aug 2025!)
✅ Loft w/ bar area + extra living space
✅ Mature trees, sprinklers & fenced backyard

Kati will be there to welcome you, answer questions, and guide you through your next step toward homeownership! ✨

👉 Tag a friend who’s house hunting and stop by to see if this could be the one!
